text:
alex: Kicking off an accordion-style canary for the new routing weights. Plan: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~90m. Need smoke owners for first two steps and a rollback ready. cc @sre-oncall

nina: I'll take the 1% -> 5% smoke window. Will run the latency & error-rate checklist.

sam: I'll own rollback scripts and the hotfix patch if we need a fast pin. Have a `rollback.sh` ready: `./rollback.sh --tag previous-deploy`

lee: Which cohorts are we selecting? Prefer low-traffic cohorts first (NA-east + EU-west small buckets). Also confirm we keep the older model variant as fallback.

kai: confirming cohort sets: NA-east: small-geo-1, EU-west: small-geo-2, APAC excluded for first day. Percent buckets assigned to those cohorts for the 1% and 5% windows.

sre-oncall: I'm on deck during the 1% -> 5% window. I'll subscribe to the smoke alerts and will be ready to trigger rollback. Post the runbook link here.

release-bot: Deploy plan created: `accordion-ramp-v2` by alex. Scheduled start 2026-03-18T15:20Z. Automated metrics will ping #eng-sre and this thread.

alex: Quick checklist:
- owner for 1%->5% smoke: nina
- rollback owner: sam
- oncall: sre-oncall
- cohorts: kai
- monitor dash: /dash/requests/routing-weight-v2

nina: Smoke checklist (short):
1) sanity queries for top-10 user flows (10m)
2) tail latency P95/P99 < baseline +20% for 10m
3) error rate delta < 0.1%
4) KV cache hit rate stable
If anything fails, ping here and tag @sam to rollback.

sam: Rollback plan:
1) Run `curl -X POST https://ops-api/release/rollback -d '{"policy":"accordion-ramp-v2"}'` (this reverts weight config)
2) Re-deploy previous routing config via `deployctl promote previous`
3) Notify customers via status page if >10m degradation
I'll leave `rollback-prep` locked to my username until end of run.

lee: Can we delay the 25% step until we validate 5% for 30m? I'm worried about downstream batch jobs.

alex: Yep. Hold on 25% until we get a green 30m pass at 5%. Update ramp to manual after 5%.

kai: Adding a small canary tag to logs so we can slice traffic in observability: `X-Canary: accordion-v2` — will also attach cohort-id.

sre-oncall: Set alert thresholds: latency > baseline+25% for 5m OR error increase >0.2% for 5m -> auto notify and escalate. I'll push those rules now.

release-bot: Preflight checks: all CI green, infra capacity check passed, no outstanding deploy holds.

alex: Final ask before start: nina confirm you have the smoke runbook link and can run the checks at start time. sam confirm rollback script reachable. If both yes, we start at T+5m.

nina: Runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/smoke/accordion-ramp-v2. Ready.

sam: Rollback script is staged at https://ops/release/rollback-prep and has my SSH key access. Ready.

lee: :thumbsup:

release-bot: Canary started at 0.5% -> routing adjustments in flight. Metrics streaming to /dash/requests/routing-weight-v2.

alex: Thanks team — I'll post updates at each step. If anybody sees anything odd, drop a short note here (latency/error/count).
